name: Bhutan (1949–1956)
description: A field divided diagonally from the lower hoist to the upper fly into yellow above and red below, with a green dragon (Druk) facing the hoist across the centre.
history: The first national flag of Bhutan, designed at the request of the second Druk Gyalpo, Jigme Wangchuck, and displayed in 1949 at the signing of the Indo-Bhutan Treaty; it is known from black-and-white photographs, with a green dragon on a nearly square yellow and red field. It was superseded in 1956 by a version with a white dragon.
